title: benchmark-lab: add reporting pipeline v62 and profiling baselines for mixed workloads
author: Ava Martinez
description: Background: the benchmark lab needs an updated reporting pipeline to support mixed-workload profiling and the next round of automated baselines. This PR introduces reporting pipeline v62, adds representative mixed-workload runners, and records new profiling baselines for v62 so downstream dashboards and periodic regressions alerts can consume stable data. Motivation: consistent end-to-end reports for mixed workloads reduce flakiness in perf regressions, enable automated alerts tied to baseline changes, and let SREs validate autoscaling tweaks in Dedicated. Changes: 1) pipeline: new CI/CD pipeline definition and deploy helper for v62 reporting (benchmark-lab/pipelines/reporting/v62/pipeline.yaml, scripts/infra/deploy_reporting.sh) 2) runners: added mixed_workload_runner with concurrency and trace hooks (benchmark-lab/runners/mixed_workload_runner.py) 3) profiling: baseline artifacts and README for v62 (benchmark-lab/profiling/baselines/v62/config.json, README.md) 4) observability: dashboard snapshot and metric tags to drive regression alerts (observability/metrics/benchmark_lab_dashboard.json) 5) tests: unit+integration tests for runner and pipeline (tests/benchmark-lab/test_mixed_runner.py, ci/pipeline-tests/benchmark-lab.yaml) Implementation notes: the runner uses the existing batching harness with workload definitions serialized as JSON; KV cache warmup was added to reduce variance; pipeline stages include validate->profile->report->upload. I added a lightweight staged rollout for the reporting ingest to avoid backfilling storms. Checklist: - [x] Add reporting pipeline v62 - [x] Add mixed workload runner and unit tests - [x] Add profiling baselines and README - [x] CI pipeline integration and smoke tests - [x] Dashboard snapshot and alert wiring - [x] Documentation: release notes updated Related: ENG-4012 (automated baselines), ENG-4120 (mixed workload runners). Testing: CI passed on first run after a flaky test was fixed; integration smoke runs completed in staging. Rollout: merged to main and deployed to staging reporting infra; will monitor metrics for 48h. Release notes: Added reporting pipeline v62 and profiling baselines for mixed workloads. No breaking API changes.
